scope: bounded public mobile Store Locator host-isolation evidence with no authentication, form submission, direct API use, or active security testing

findings.title: Mobile Store Locator crashes when the maps.googleapis.com script is unavailable
findings.claim: Blocking the single script request served from maps.googleapis.com causes the same generic unrecoverable application-error state and removes Store Locator identity and search inputs in all three fresh mobile contexts; restoring scripts returns the exact meaningful baseline in all three contexts.

causal_memory.state_scope: maps.googleapis.com script availability, generic app error, search controls, route identity, and recovery
causal_memory.time_scope: 3/3 fresh mobile contexts on 2026-07-19 at exact head 33608dcdc0f9854afab19a111469fd870e8037bd

user_control.user_effect: A mobile visitor loses the Store Locator and all three visible search inputs and receives only a generic whole-application error with refresh guidance.

findings.minimal_fix: Contain Maps JavaScript load failure inside the map component, keep store search or list results usable, and show a specific accessible recovery state instead of replacing the entire application with a generic crash screen.
findings.regression_test: In the mobile Store Locator, fail the maps.googleapis.com script load and assert that the page retains Store Locator identity, an accessible search or list fallback, a specific explanation, and a retry action without a whole-app error boundary.

findings.title: Not every stable third-party script host independently crashes Store Locator
findings.surface: mobile public Store Locator third-party script controls
findings.claim: Blocking any stable third-party script host independently causes the mobile Store Locator generic application crash.

causal_memory.state_scope: independent blocking of seven stable third-party script hosts
causal_memory.time_scope: seven hosts × three fresh treatment contexts on 2026-07-19

user_control.user_effect: No user-control loss is assigned to the seven hosts that remained meaningful in all bounded treatment rounds.

findings.minimal_fix: Preserve the seven neutral host controls as negative causal memory and avoid attributing the grouped third-party failure to all external scripts.
findings.regression_test: Keep one-host-at-a-time controls so a future dependency claim must reproduce the crash in three fresh contexts while unrelated stable hosts remain functional.

findings.title: The resources.xg4ken.com dependency remains untested
findings.surface: mobile public Store Locator third-party inventory
findings.claim: Blocking resources.xg4ken.com independently causes or does not cause the mobile Store Locator failure.

counterfactual.reason: The stable host ranked ninth and was excluded by the preconfigured eight-host isolation cap.

causal_memory.state_scope: resources.xg4ken.com script availability and visible Store Locator behavior
causal_memory.time_scope: observed in inventory on 2026-07-19 but not isolated

user_control.user_effect: No user impact or neutrality conclusion is assigned because this stable inventory host was not isolated.

findings.minimal_fix: Run the same three-round baseline, exact-host block, and recovery treatment for resources.xg4ken.com before assigning any causal role.
findings.regression_test: Extend the bounded candidate set by one host without changing thresholds and require three fresh contexts with an exact blocked-script count and recovery evidence.
